metrics.source: Notebook output, reproduced exactly from the raw CSV in audit report section 8.1

training_ranges.source: Exact min/max of the notebook-cleaned data, all splits (9,995 rows); reproduced by training/notebook_cleaning.py

risk_tiers.note: Interim cut-offs on the RAW score, read off the audit report's test-set calibration table (section 8.3b): raw < 0.50 -> observed churn <= 13.6%; 0.50-0.60 -> 24.6%; >= 0.60 -> 53-85%. After fitting a calibrator (training/fit_calibrator.py) switch to calibrated 0.15 / 0.40 cut-offs.

known_limitations: The raw XGBoost score is not a calibrated probability: mean predicted 0.424 vs observed churn 0.204 on the test set.
The 0.5 threshold is a grid-boundary artifact of the notebook's threshold sweep (audit report section 8.2), not a tuned optimum.
Winsorisation clips discrete features (e.g. NumOfProducts to 3.5), so 3- and 4-product customers are treated alike.
